description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). MUST use MULTIPLE metadata fields to produce at least 20 distinct scores across 34 fingerprints. Required fields: first_seen, last_updated, update_frequency_days, version_count, release_interval_avg, stability_flags. Penalize frequent version churn, reward consistent release Cadence. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. This is the THIRD attempt to break the 3-distinct-value plateau. Reference: Signal Quality Diagnostic shows temporal_stability has only 3 distinct values with range 40-90.
